answer: An agent economy can root every identity in a single verified lineage, like a willow growing branches from one trunk: each new branch splits the same finite flow of standing, so the fiftieth fake identity inherits almost nothing. Standing then matures at a glacier's pace, earned only through a long, unbroken record of useful work that no payment can hurry, and a vault of shared history records every branch's deeds. Forging a hundred convincing identities would take a hundred lifetimes of real work, which no attacker can buy in bulk or run in parallel.
